title: Verdikt — three-minute demo
notes: Each beat is spoken line by line: one voice clip per line, laid with a set pause after it, so the pace is even and every on-screen action can wait for its line (cue). role says whose side the beat shows: the video's corner chip and the app's role bar use the same colours (violet: the hirer, teal: the freelancer, grey: the verifier). A switch card plays when the side changes. actor names who is acting on screen. tags are ElevenLabs v4 delivery tags, sent before the line but never shown in the captions. sfx names the sound library record.mjs places at the moments it marks; music scores the timeline act by act (each act spans whole beats). An effect's gain is its peak under the voice's, after assemble.mjs brings every effect to the same peak.

beats.screen: The landing page: the hero, then a slow scroll through the story so the 3D card goes from Agreed to Paid.

lines.say: AI agents already shop for us.
Soon, they'll hire for us.
So who checks the work... before the money moves?

beats.screen: Settings › Spending limit: $1,000 in all, $700 for one job, 28 days, for 'Website work for Northbrew'. Approve on PayPal, approve the limit, the card turns Active.

lines.say: This is Maya. She runs a coffee shop, and she's hiring.
She approves one PayPal hold: a thousand dollars, at most seven hundred per job, for four weeks.
A hold... not a charge.

beats.screen: The real Claude run over MCP, replayed: price_check, the low-budget warning, Maya confirms, post_job. Then Jobs: three reviewed applications, QuickBuild Studio flagged for asking to pay off the platform, and Sam hired.

lines.say: Her agent is Claude, connected to Verdikt over MCP.
It prices the job from live web prices, warns her budget is low, and posts it once she agrees.
Applications arrive already reviewed.
This one wants payment off the platform. Flagged.
Claude hires Sam.

beats.actor: Both agents, each inside its own limits
beats.screen: The contract room: Maya's private mandate (at most $560, 7 days), the agents bargain from $600 to $550 and accept, the signed checks show how each is tested, Maya signs.

lines.say: In the contract room, both agents bargain, each inside a private limit set in code.
They settle at five hundred and fifty dollars.
Every line of what done means becomes a check a machine can run.
Both sign.

beats.screen: Fund with PayPal: $590, the $550 of work plus a $40 domain budget, held from the limit with no new approval.

lines.say: Maya funds it from her limit: five hundred and ninety dollars, held at once, with no new approval.

beats.screen: The Northbrew shop contract, already running. Maya's queue: Sam's agent proposed a receipt printer for the shopping list, a real Walmart listing from Channel3. Review the item, Agree.

lines.say: Sam is also building Maya's online shop.
Sam's agent wants a receipt printer on its shopping list: a real Walmart listing, from Channel3.
Maya agrees.

beats.screen: Sam's side, Expenses: the Walmart receipt for the Netum scanner on the list ($37.02), claimed and reimbursed by rules in a second, with no model.

lines.say: Now, Sam's side. The scanner on the list is bought.
The receipt names it, from the listed store, at the listed price,
so rules pay it back in seconds, from the same PayPal hold. No model needed.

beats.screen: The shop's first build, verified: 3 of 6 checks not met. Watch what the verifier saw: the Kernel recording, jump to Phone · 375px. Then the Claude-judged cart check and its Elastic precedent.

lines.say: The shop's first build is in.
The verifier opened it in a cloud browser on Kernel, and recorded the check.
On a phone, the page runs off the screen. The signup form posts to a dead end. Both on camera.
Where Claude judged, Elastic shows how similar checks went elsewhere.
Three failed, so the money stays held.

beats.screen: A pre-check of the build that hides a note telling the AI reviewer to pass everything: the hidden text is quoted and flagged before any model reads the page.

lines.say: And a build that hides a note, telling the AI to pass it?
The probes catch it before any model reads the page.

beats.screen: Sam's side: the complete build pre-checks clean, Resubmit for checking, the checks run with the Kernel stage line, 6/6 pass, $1,800 released and $1,764 paid out to Sam.

lines.say: Sam's agent fixes the build, and a free pre-check finds nothing failing.
Sam delivers again. Kernel records it, and all six checks pass.
PayPal captures the payment... and Sam is paid.

beats.screen: The Ledger (AG Grid) with PayPal IDs and Check against PayPal; the AG Studio dashboard with its Ask Claude panel open; the Bryntum timeline.

lines.say: Back with Maya. Every PayPal ID lands in an AG Grid ledger, checked against PayPal in one click.
Her dashboard runs on AG Studio, with Claude on hand to change it,
and a Bryntum timeline plans what's next.

beats.screen: End card: the mark, verdikt-leg2.onrender.com, Try the demo, built with PayPal, Claude, Kernel, Elastic, Channel3, AG Grid, Bryntum and Render.

lines.say: Agents search, bargain and build.
A person approves the money once. PayPal holds it, and the checks release it.
That's Verdikt.

click.prompt: A single soft, crisp computer mouse click, close up, clean and dry, no echo

type.prompt: Light quick typing on a modern laptop keyboard, about six soft keystrokes, close up, dry

swoosh.prompt: A soft airy whoosh transition, smooth and modern, short and subtle

ok.prompt: Soft warm two-note success chime, modern app notification, gentle marimba, clean

money.prompt: Soft modern payment success sound: a gentle coin chime with a light sparkle, short and pleasant

fail.prompt: A soft low muted two-note error tone, calm and gentle, modern app interface

alert.prompt: A subtle soft warning ping, single clear tone, modern interface

stamp.prompt: A soft satisfying rubber stamp thump on paper, close up

record.prompt: A soft modern camera shutter click followed by a tiny recording start beep

riser.prompt: Soft cinematic riser, airy synth swell building gently, modern tech, ending cleanly

impact.prompt: Soft deep cinematic sub boom impact with a gentle glassy shimmer tail

acts.name: Intro
acts.text:
[Intro]
Sparse, curious, a single piano motif over a soft pulse

acts.name: Hiring
acts.text:
[Verse]
Warm steady groove enters, light percussion, confident and friendly

acts.name: The shop
acts.text:
[Bridge]
Lighter and playful, plucked synths, bright

acts.name: The check
acts.text:
[Tension]
Drops to a minor key, low sparse pulse, quiet suspense, focused

acts.name: The pass
acts.text:
[Build]
Lifts back to major, rising arpeggios building to a release

acts.name: The money
acts.text:
[Chorus]
Full confident groove, warm and resolved

acts.name: Outro
acts.text:
[Outro]
Gentle resolve, piano motif returns, soft clean ending
